"Once Upon a Time in the East" (2011) is a documentary film directed by Davor Borić. It explores various aspects of Eastern Europe in the wake of its post-communist transition. The documentary provides insights into the political, social, and economic transformations that Eastern European countries went through during and after the dissolution of the Soviet Union.

The film weaves personal stories with historical analysis, showing the impact of these massive changes on ordinary people’s lives. It also delves into the cultural shifts and identity crises experienced by these nations as they moved from communist systems to more democratic and market-oriented societies.
